attribution.method: All retained sessions are included except the heartbeat bug and its child session. Exact metadata labels organize named projects; remaining sessions are grouped as Other maccrate.ai work.

coverageNotes: A session with no model, token, route, or tool metadata remains in the session total but is omitted from model comparisons.
Token totals use session_model_usage when present and fall back to session totals only when no usage rows exist.
Model session counts are participation counts, so a model-switched session can appear under more than one model.
Costs, durations, success/failure, and stages are not published because coverage is not comparable.
